title: Wampur language - Wikipedia
text: Wampur is a minor Austronesian language of Madang Province, Papua New Guinea. It is spoken in the two villages of Wampur ( 6.376584°S 146.15515°E) and Mirir ( 6.422483°S 146.156993°E) in Onga-Waffa Rural LLG. [2]
